floors_confirmed_by: offline runs 2026-08-02 (runs/puz/v2-floors): always-pass 0.096, first 0.308, oracle 1.000; random single-draw 0.404 vs analytic 0.28 (one k=1 realization, 2sigma-high — quote the analytic value)
known_limits: NO live model has been scored against this suite at freeze time; informative-position count is unknown until the v2 tournament runs.

39 rollout keys were minted on linux-x86_64 (EC2) replays of darwin-mined games. probe_matches enforced byte-identical decision menus per position; however the seed-42 full-game canary shows an identity-label flip between platforms, so cross-platform FULL-GAME outcomes are not interchangeable — only replay-validated forks were used.
The cloud confirm pass stalled at ~84% (26 rollout_timeout rows, 2.9% infra rate, under the 0.05 gate); ~175 sampled positions were never measured and remain available for a v2.1 extension.
Category skew: 35/52 lethal-now. Free-position fraction unknown until scored; expect the discriminating subset to be substantially smaller than 52.
All overnight-1/2 keys carry unprobed_replay_address (see puz-v1 manifest); round-4-7 exhaustive keys likewise (--driver none).

SNAPSHOT DEFECT (found 2026-08-02, fixed for future corpora): the 'mana available' line double-counted basic lands (subtype + intrinsic mana ability), e.g. 2 untapped Mountains rendered {R:4}. Rows frozen in this suite embed the wrong tally (50/65 affected in puz-v2.1 by the strict test). Scores on this suite reflect models coping with self-contradictory mana state; cross-suite comparisons to post-fix suites are not mana-line-equivalent.
